It took place in Qatar from 20 November to 18 December 2022, after the country was awarded the hosting rights in 2010. It was the first World Cup to be held in the Middle East and the Arabian Peninsula, and the second in an Asian country after the 2002 tournament in South Korea and Japan. This tournament was the last with 32 participating teams, before increasing to 48 for the 2026 World Cup. To avoid the extremes of Qatar's hot climate in summers, the event was held in November and December, becoming the first to take place in the end of the year and outside the traditional months of May, June, and July.
